## Capabilities
- 600x600 additive display simulation (black = transparent)
- environment backgrounds: scenes, upload, animated, webcam
- D-pad input: on-screen pad + arrow-key/Enter/Escape
- display tuning: brightness, blur, auto-dimming, frame overlay
- 600x600 WebM viewport recording
- automated QA checklist + 0-100 performance score
- voice pipeline: wake-word simulation, STT, decision, TTS
- avatar state machine with legal-transition enforcement
- hardware adapter conformance suite (3 backends)
